en.headline: Government drops Peak light installations after local concerns
en.dek: The Tourism Board will remove all related equipment along Lugard Road and Harlech Road after officials concluded the scaled-down project no longer justified proceeding.
body: The government has decided not to proceed with the Hong Kong Tourism Board’s planned Illuminations at The Peak project after considering local feedback and the expected impact of a reduced scheme.

In a paper submitted to the Central and Western District Council, the Tourism Commission and the Tourism Board said they had examined options including cutting the number of points from 10 to 7 and shortening the period to the end of February. They concluded that further reductions would make it difficult to deliver the intended lighting effects and might not fully address residents’ concerns about the natural environment.

The Board said it would remove all remaining installations as soon as possible and restore the affected areas to their original condition. Officials noted that other year-end festive programmes already provide alternative visitor experiences.

zh.headline: 政府決定不再推展山頂光影匯 旅發局將拆除裝置
zh.dek: 當局綜合考慮地區意見及縮減後預期成效，認為無迫切需要繼續，旅發局會盡快拆除盧吉道及夏力道相關裝置並修復環境。
body: 政府及旅遊事務署今日向中西區區議會提交文件，宣布不再推展旅發局原定於山頂盧吉道及夏力道一帶推出的「山頂光影匯」項目。
當局表示，曾考慮將景點由10個減至7個、推行期縮短至明年2月底，並減少懸掛燈具的樹木數量，但評估後認為大幅縮減後難以完整呈現原有燈光效果，亦未必能完全釋除居民對自然環境的疑慮。
旅發局會盡快拆除所有相關裝置，並全面修復受影響地方，盡快恢復原貌。政府指年底已有冬日巡禮等節慶活動，旅客有更多選擇。
